'''Toma dur Ahmid''' devised the [[Toman Calendar]]. 

==History==
After the [[Breaking of the World]], many of the world's records had been destroyed. Toma dur Ahmid created a new calendar that started after the death of the last male [[Aes Sedai (Age of Legends)|Aes Sedai]]. The calendar recorded years [[After Breaking]], or AB.{{ref/book|1|g}}
